meta.title: Choosing a template on a fresh stage populates the sheet schema

plan.title: UI-TPL-001 Choosing a template on a fresh stage populates the sheet schema

steps.note: Open the eRFX event-create screen to start with a fresh stage.
Provide a mandatory title for the new event.
Pick the stage's pricing template as specified in the test case steps.
Assert that the template name replaces the prompt on the current stage.
Assert that the pricing sheet's header row has rendered with columns from the template.
